newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA ION TIRIAC BANK TO SIGN A SYNDICATED LOAN.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA ION TIRIAC BANK TO SIGN A SYNDICATED LOAN.

text.p: Romanian private bank Banca Ion Tiriac SA said on Tuesday it would sign a syndicated loan with London Forfaiting Asia Ltd this week.
The accord will be signed in Bucharest on Friday, a bank statement said. It said details on the deal would be available after the signing ceremony.
Banking sources told Reuters that Banca Ion Tiriac was expected to raise about $40 million with London Forfaiting Asia acting as lead manager for the syndication.

Ion Tiriac bank was the first private commercial bank opened in Romania after the 1989 fall of communism. It was founded by Ion Tiriac, a Romanian former tennis star who once managed Boris Becker. The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development holds 20 percent of the bank's share capital.
